text_block_list.text:
One day, I step into my office and find<n>Biwa
Hayahide muttering to herself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm. This section looks fine...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd still like to test the strength and<n>elasticity of the
fabric, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I can't forget to check how<n>the outfit
moves and looks while I'm<n>on stage...

Biwa Hayahide is examining her<n>signature
racewear closely and<n>making detailed notes of her
findings.

She already evaluated the outfit a<n>while ago when it
first arrived and<n>tried it on, but I suppose she isn't
done yet.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hello there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to ask for your opinion,<n>but do you
notice anything off about<n>my outfit?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can be honest. I'm trying to<n>identify and make
note of any issues.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well... yes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You'll probably say I'm overthinking<n>it, but I just
can't relax until I've<n>made sure everything is
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've encountered so many<n>exceptional athletes
since I entered<n>Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're able to adapt quickly to<n>unexpected
circumstances and don't<n>hesitate to let go of the
old if the need<n>ever comes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And they're capable of overcoming<n>challenges with
their extraordinary<n>strength.
However, I lack such qualities.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know it would benefit me to learn by<n>their
example, but I can't bring myself<n>to let go of the
things I've<n>accumulated over the years.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So the only thing I can do is prepare<n>as much as
possible in advance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, this method may forever<n>doom me to
being no more than an<n>ordinary racer.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you try stopping your note-taking for a
while?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
choice_data_list: Can I take a look at your notes?

text_block_list.text: Sure, I don't mind.

I'm shocked by the overwhelming<n>volume of notes
that I find in her<n>notebook.

There are detailed analyses of every<n>track,
placement records, and<n>strategies on how to
improve her<n>performance before a race.

Everything Biwa Hayahide has<n>learned through trial
and error is<n>meticulously recorded.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Trainer? You're<n>awfully quiet...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

The more one prepares for every<n>eventuality, the
more they're able to<n>perform at full potential.

However, not everyone has the ability<n>to do this. I
tell her that her attention to<n>detail and analytical
ability is what<n>sets her apart.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have a point. That's certainly one<n>way to look
at it.
choice_data_list:
Let's take full advantage of this secret power of
yours!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suppose if this weapon is unique<n>only to myself,
then there's no need<n>to compare myself to others,
is there?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I feel like a new path of<n>possibility has
been opened up to me.

There's no magic equation for<n>growth. And that's
exactly why I'm<n>eager to keep learning through trial
and error with her until we find<n>what's right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've tried several times...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I've never been able to stay calm<n>without it. I
become so anxious that I<n>always end up with my
notebook in<n>my hands before I realize it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I truly wanted to stop, I would<n>require enough
nerve to simply tear<n>the whole thing apart.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, it's true. I'd have to burn<n>that bridge,
so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't even need this anymore!

Biwa Hayahide moves to destroy her<n>notebook,
and in a panic I reach out to<n>stop her. Before I can,
however, her<n>face crumples.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... I can't do it!

I don't have it in me to compete<n>against such
strong opponents<n>entirely unprepared... I just
don't!

Seeing how stressed she is by this<n>ordeal, I start to
think that pushing her<n>to make such a radical
change might<n>not be the best approach.
Instead, I take a breath and say...
choice_data_list:
That's all right! There's no need to destroy your
notes!

That's all right! There's no need to destroy your
notes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But if I don't...
choice_data_list:
Don't worry. We can simply do what works for
you!

text_block_list.text:
I tell her there's nothing wrong with<n>taking detailed
notes on items of<n>concern—rather, they can be a
vital<n>tool for her growth.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I really don't need to get rid of them?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Maybe you're right... Maybe it'sbetter to work with myself rather thanagainst.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that has taken such<n>a weight off
my shoulders. Thank you<n>so much, Trainer.

We spend time going over her notes,<n>discuss her
most recent areas of<n>concern, and brainstorm ways
to<n>tackle them together.
